data_sufficiency.exam_focus: GRE Data Sufficiency emphasizes analytical skills over computational prowess
question_features: Focus on Logical Reasoning over Calculation
Subtlety and Nuance in question wording
Implicit vs. Explicit Information between statements
Fair tricks that test analytical thoroughness
data_sufficiency.academic_context: Questions should reflect academic and research scenarios
data_sufficiency.vocabulary_level: Use advanced academic vocabulary appropriate for graduate studies

numeric_entry.exam_focus: GRE Numeric Entry tests precise mathematical computation
numeric_entry.answer_format: Open-ended numerical answers with 2 decimal places precision
numeric_entry.academic_context: Mathematical problems suitable for graduate-level academic work

problem_solving.exam_focus: GRE Problem Solving tests quantitative reasoning and mathematical knowledge
problem_solving.difficulty_scaling: Progressive complexity in mathematical reasoning and concepts

quantitative_comparison.exam_focus: GRE Quantitative Comparison tests ability to compare mathematical expressions
quantitative_comparison.question_structure: Compare Quantity A and Quantity B with shared graphs/tables
quantitative_comparison.academic_context: Mathematical comparisons relevant to graduate studies

reading_comprehension.exam_focus: GRE Reading Comprehension emphasizes academic and scholarly passages
reading_comprehension.passage_types: Academic research, scientific studies, literary analysis, historical texts
reading_comprehension.length_variations: rc-s (2 questions), rc-m (3 questions), rc-l (4 questions)
reading_comprehension.academic_context: Passages should reflect graduate-level academic content and complexity

text_completion.exam_focus: GRE Text Completion tests vocabulary and contextual reasoning
text_completion.academic_context: Academic and scholarly text with sophisticated vocabulary
text_completion.completion_types: Single blank, double blank, triple blank completions

sentence_equivalence.exam_focus: GRE Sentence Equivalence tests vocabulary and meaning equivalence
sentence_equivalence.academic_context: Academic writing with precise vocabulary choices
sentence_equivalence.question_structure: Select two answers that create equivalent meanings
